subject: general
question: Tertiary activities are also known as the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**service sector**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The tertiary sector is commonly referred to as the **service sector** because it provides services rather than goods.
 
• It includes activities such as **retail, education, healthcare, banking, IT services, transportation, and entertainment**.
 
• This sector does not involve the production or manufacturing of goods but rather focuses on the **distribution and support of goods and services**.
 
• In modern economies, the service sector often contributes the largest share to the Gross Domestic Product (GDP).
 
• The growth of the service sector is driven by factors such as **urbanization, globalization, technological advancements, and rising consumer demand for specialized services**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Health Sector**

 
 
• The health sector is a part of the service sector but focuses specifically on **healthcare services**, including hospitals, clinics, diagnostics, and pharmaceuticals.
 
• It plays a crucial role in improving the health and well-being of individuals and communities.
 
• While it overlaps with the service sector, it is not synonymous with the term "tertiary activities."
 
 
 
• **Industrial Sector**
 
 
• The industrial sector is also known as the **secondary sector** and involves activities related to the **manufacturing, processing, and construction of goods**.
 
• This sector converts raw materials from the primary sector into finished products through industrial processes.
 
• Examples include factories, steel production, and automobile manufacturing.
 
 
 
• **Agricultural Sector**
 
 
• The agricultural sector, also referred to as the **primary sector**, involves activities related to **farming, fishing, forestry, and mining**.
 
• It focuses on the extraction of natural resources and raw materials that serve as the foundation for other sectors.
 
• This sector is essential for food production and resource availability.
